levels.surface: جبير بن محمد بن جبير بن مطعم

notes: The Tirmidhi remark «قال أبو عيسى وقد روى بعضهم ...» names a different chain for the same saying: a variant group, never a route of the main one.
«عن أبيه» (both chains) is a relation link: no name is written for him in the main chain.
«جده جبير بن مطعم»: the «جده» + name is one link whose surface is the name alone (rule 7).
